## 9:2 (overlap: 5%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | In-the-first year of-his-reign, I, Daniel, perceived in-the-books the-number-of years which [the]-word-of YHWH came to-Jeremiah the-prophet to-fulfill — for-the-desolations-of Jerusalem — seventy years. |
| LOGOS | The LORD continued revealing Daniel's prayer and seventy weeks to Daniel. |
